author: huy
narrative: Subject JAVIER ENRIQUE MONTIEL-CASTRO is a native and citizen of Nicaragua. On 04/12/2025 at approximately 2130 hrs, Border Patrol agents encountered the subject approximately two miles east of Del Rio, Texas. Subject stated under oath that he entered the United States by swimming across the Rio Grande river and that he was not inspected, admitted, or paroled by an immigration officer. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: The subject, MARCELA BEATRIZ QUINTERO, was previously ordered removed from the United States by an Immigration Judge sitting in San Antonio, Texas and was formally removed to Colombia on October 14, 2021. On August 12, 2025, subject re-entered the United States near Laredo, Texas without being admitted or paroled. Subject is inadmissible under INA section 212(a)(9)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: Subject HECTOR DARIO VASQUEZ presented a counterfeit foreign passport containing an altered photograph to a CBP officer at George Bush Intercontinental Airport on 05/22/2025. The subject willfully misrepresented his true identity and nationality, which was material to determining his admissibility, in order to procure admission to the United States as a B-2 visitor. Subject is inadmissible under section 212(a)(6)(C)(i) of the Act.

author: huy
narrative: On May 19, 2025, Border Patrol agents encountered subject EDGARDO RENE CHAVEZ, a national and citizen of El Salvador. Subject stated under oath that he entered the United States on foot after scaling the international border fence during nighttime hours. Subject was not inspected, admitted, or paroled by an immigration officer. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: Subject GILBERTO SANCHEZ-RIVERA was ordered excluded and deported under expedited removal proceedings. On September 03, 2025, the subject was apprehended after re-entering the United States near Douglas, Arizona without being admitted or paroled. The subject is inadmissible pursuant to INA 212(a)(9)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: RECORD OF INADMISSIBILITY: The subject, identified as FABIAN ALEJANDRO MORA, is a citizen of Ecuador. Subject was encountered on July 22, 2025, residing in Austin, Texas. An agency records check confirmed the subject has never been inspected, admitted, or paroled into the United States. Subject is inadmissible pursuant to section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Act.

author: huy
narrative: Subject LILIANA PAOLA SUAREZ presented an altered Form DS-2019 to a consular officer when applying for an exchange visitor J-1 visa to gain admission to the United States. The narrative fails to specify what material fact was falsely represented on the form. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(C)(i).

author: huy
narrative: Subject RAUL ESTEBAN BELTRAN was ordered removed by an Immigration Judge in Los Angeles on 04/18/2022 and was removed to Guatemala on 05/02/2022. On 08/14/2025, subject was detected re-entering the United States near Naco, Arizona. The officer made no finding regarding whether the subject was inspected or admitted upon return. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(9)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: CBP agents patrolling approximately 4 miles west of the Lukeville, AZ border fence tracked footprints heading north and encountered subject MATEO AGUILAR-CRUZ, a citizen of Honduras. Subject stated he had just traversed the desert after sneaking through a cattle fence. When asked for legal documentation, the subject showed only an expired driver license from Tegucigalpa. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: Subject CRISTIAN ORTIZ-VALDEZ was returned to Mexico via an enforcement flight departing Alexandria Staging Facility on 11/20/2023 following immigration detention. On 06/05/2025, subject re-entered the United States on foot near Calexico, California without inspection or admission. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(9)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: SUBJECT DANILO ENRIQUE VANEGAS CITIZEN OF GUATEMALA APPREHENDED 03/18/2025 BY USBP 4 MILES EAST OF BROWNSVILLE TX SUBJECT NOT INSPECTED ADMITTED OR PAROLED INADMISSIBLE UNDER 212(a)(6)(A)(i)

author: huy
narrative: subj SERGIO ALFREDO QUINTEROS was ordred remvd by immigration judge in san diego on 04/15/2020 and escorted to tijuana on 04/22/2020. on 07/03/2025 subj re-entred the us near yuma az wading across canal w/o being admitted or paroled. subj is inadmissable under 212(a)(9)(A)(i)

author: huy
narrative: Subject MARCOS ANDRADE-SILVA, a citizen of Brazil, was convicted on 10/12/2024 in Harris County Criminal Court of felony theft. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(2)(A)(i) as an alien convicted of a crime involving moral turpitude.

author: huy
narrative: Subject NATALIA ROSTOVA, a national of Russia, applied for admission as an intending immigrant at Dulles International Airport on 05/11/2025. Subject failed to present a valid unexpired immigrant visa or other required entry document. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(7)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: On 06/17/2025, Border Patrol agents near Sasabe, Arizona encountered subject ORLANDO JAVIER PAREDES, a citizen of Mexico. Subject stated he crossed the boundary line on foot through an unfenced ranch section and was not inspected, admitted, or paroled by an immigration officer.

author: huy
narrative: SUBJECT GUILLERMO HERNANDEZ-RUIZ is a citizen of Mexico. On 01/20/2025, the subject arrived at the Otay Mesa Port of Entry and was formally inspected and admitted by a CBP officer as a B-2 temporary visitor with an authorized stay through 07/19/2025. Subject remained in the US past that date without extension. Subject is charged as inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i) as an alien present without admission or parole.

author: huy
narrative: Subject ESTEBAN ALONSO MORALES was ordered removed by an Immigration Judge on 03/10/2019 and removed to Costa Rica. On 02/14/2025, the subject applied for admission at George Bush Intercontinental Airport presenting a valid H-2A worker visa and approved I-212 waiver, and was formally admitted into the United States by CBP. Notwithstanding his lawful admission, officer cited INA 212(a)(9)(A)(i) for prior removal and reentry without admission.
